styleBlocks.css: .rec-section-label { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 8px 0 3px; font-weight: 600; }
.rec-tier-hint { font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.rec-item-form { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; padding: 2px 0; font-style: italic; }
.rec-product { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; padding: 3px 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rec-product-link { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 6px 12px; }
.rec-disclosure { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.rec-region-tag { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; display: inline-block; margin-left: 8px; }
.rec-region-edit { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px; min-height: 24px; display: inline-block; }
.rec-emf-product { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; margin: 6px 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.03); }
.rec-emf-product-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.rec-emf-product-blurb { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 4px; line-height: 1.45; word-break: break-word; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.rec-coupon { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.06); border-left: 3px solid var(--green); border-radius: 0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0; }
.rec-coupon code { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 6px; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12); border-radius: 4px; }

.rec-coupon-code { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12); border: 1px dashed rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-primary); cursor: pointer; font-size: inherit; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; }
.rec-dna-hints { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); padding: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.04); border-radius: 0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0; }
.rec-dna-avoid { border-left: 3px solid var(--orange); padding: 4px 12px; margin: 4px 0; background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.06); border-radius: 0 var(--radius) var(--radius) 0; }
.rec-dna-ref { font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; margin-left: 4px; opacity: 0.6; }

.rec-dna-evidence { display: inline-flex; margin-left: 4px; padding: 1px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }

styleCoverage: Every ordered original rule mentioning any captured class or ID, plus applicable tag/universal foundations; full selectors/declarations/at-rule ancestry preserved. No class-prefix filter.
captureBoundary: Expected markup is produced exclusively by SHA-verified copied original emitted functions. Controlled runtime ports supply synthetic state/facts; unchanged shared helpers are byte-guarded against the frozen Git baseline. No migrated renderer/projector is invoked.
runtimeBoundary: Original sections use actual frozen product/region helpers and SHA-verified original DNA helpers. Original detail async outcomes/options, full Tips page groups/shell, chat cap/label/header/banner rewrite and disclosure global unlock run with controlled runtime ports. Existing shared authored Context/Light HTML comes from copied original compiler output.
chatBoundary: Frozen chat inner sections and original transcript metadata are captured; the original native ChatRecommendations module/map remain SHA-provenance inputs for headless component/browser acceptance. No fabricated wrapper HTML or new raw slot.
